gh_2053fcbed89f4b0a9f16deab.title: LINE Pay Vietnam - Backend Engineer - Saigon, District 10
gh_2053fcbed89f4b0a9f16deab.description:
## Location

* District 10, HCMC, Vietnam


## Summary
- We are looking for a Mid/Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, maintain, and improve large-scale backend services. The role involves working on distributed systems that support user-facing products, business operations, partner integrations, and mission-critical transaction flows.
- You will collaborate with product, QA, operations, and overseas engineering teams to deliver reliable backend features, improve system performance, and support production stability.

### Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and enhance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
- Build and operate scalable APIs and service-to-service integrations for user- facing and internal business systems.
- Work with distributed system components such as relational databases, message queues, caches, search platforms, and file/object storage.
- Participate in designing reliable workflows for business-critical operations such as transaction processing, asynchronous events, data synchronization, reporting, and reconciliation.
- Investigate and resolve production issues across APIs, background jobs, messaging systems, caches, databases, and external integrations.
- Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, observability, and maintainability.
- Write clean, testable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews.
- Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams to clarify requirements, design solutions, and deliver features safely.
- Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, onboarding materials, and operational knowledge sharing.

### Requirements
- Over 5 years of experience in backend development, preferably with large-scale or distributed systems.
- Strong proficiency in Java and hands-on experience with Spring Boot.
- Solid experience designing, implementing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and
backend services.
- Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, including basic schema design, query optimization, transaction handling, and data consistency.
- Experience with Kafka or similar messaging systems, including asynchronous processing, producer/consumer patterns, retry handling, and idempotency.
- Experience with Redis or similar caching systems for caching, temporary state management, distributed locking, or rate limiting.
- Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other search/indexing platforms is a plus.
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud/container- based deployment is a plus.
- Understanding of system reliability topics such as logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, performance tuning, and incident investigation.
- Strong understanding of testing practices, code review, maintainability, secure coding, and production-safe rollout.
- Good communication skills and willingness to work with international stakeholders.


### Preferred Qualification
- Experience in payment, fintech, e-commerce, order management, settlement, coupon/voucher, or other transaction-heavy systems.
- Experience designing high-consistency workflows such as checkout, payment, refund, inventory, reconciliation, or asynchronous fulfillment.
- Experience operating scheduled jobs, batch processing, retry workflows, and incident recovery procedures.
- Experience with API gateways, authentication/authorization, or secure service-to- service communication.
- Experience with object storage, file export/import workflows, or reporting systems.
- Ability to document architecture clearly, including service boundaries, API contracts, data ownership, operational runbooks, and failure scenarios.


### Contact

Send your CV to email: tungnt@linecorp.com

On our mobile engineering team, you will have an opportunity to take ownership over your work that reaches millions of daily users. We take great pride in our craft, delivering a high-quality service to millions of players every single day. Teamwork is a critical part of how we get there. We believe that with an all-in approach we can deliver a better product, make better decisions, and nurture a better work environment. Everyone here is committed to making our games the best experience for our players. Join us as we pursue challenges developing and operating products at scale, influencing millions of players daily and support our game to achieve the highest levels of success!   Main Responsibilities * Work on the Words With Friends mobile client team in React Native/Unity * Architect, write, and ship elegant and maintainable code * Collaborate with your team to build game features, robust systems and UI that looks great and runs smoothly * Conduct regular code reviews to ensure high quality * Mentor others on the team to help them succeed Desired Skills and Experience * BS in Computer Science or Engineering field with at least 5 years of development experience * Experience with Unity and /or React Native. * Experience with backend technologies is a bonus. * Experience in Git or a similar version control system * Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions * Excellent written and oral communication skills * Good mentoring skills * Prior Game Development Experience What we offer you * Competitive salary, bonus plan, Zynga RSU’s (Restricted Stock Units), ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan) * RRSP Company Match Contribution * Extended Health coverage, dental, disability, critical illness, EAP, and life insurance * Virtual mental health and neurodiversity support programs * Goodlife fitness annual membership * Open vacation policy * Family planning support program * Generous paid maternity/parental leave * Subsidized Back-up child care * Zynga happy hours and frequent employee events * Casual dress every single day * Culture of diversity and inclusion including employee resource groups * Work with cool people and impact millions of daily players Zynga is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud of our diverse community; we do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, disability, or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable law. We welcome candidates, players, employees, and partners from all backgrounds. Join us! Zynga will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. Zynga is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities.  If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let us know.   #Salary and compensation No salary data published by company so we estimated salary based on previous jobs related to Developer, Senior and Engineer. $70,000 — $120,000/year ### Location 🌏 Worldwide
